raw_response.title: Maya Character Rigging - Part 9. create FK, IK and Skin leg joint

steps.goal: Create a leg joint chain in side view
steps.visual_evidence: Joint tool is activated and joints are created sequentially down the leg.

steps.goal: Position leg joints to align with character mesh landmarks
steps.visual_evidence: Joints are moved in front and side orthographic views using Move Tool.

steps.goal: Rename skin leg joints with proper side and hierarchy tags
steps.visual_evidence: Joints in Outliner renamed to left_hip_skin_jnt, left_knee_skin_jnt, etc.

steps.goal: Orient the leg joint chain axes
steps.visual_evidence: Orient Joint Options window open, setting Primary Axis to X, Secondary Axis to Y.

steps.goal: Duplicate skin leg chain to create IK and FK joint chains and rename them
steps.visual_evidence: Search and Replace Names dialog used to replace 'skin' with 'ik' and 'fk'.

steps.goal: Parent constrain skin leg joints between IK and FK joint counterparts
steps.visual_evidence: Selecting IK joint, FK joint, then Skin joint, applying Parent Constraint with Maintain Offset enabled.

steps.goal: Create 3D text geometry control for FK/IK switch
steps.visual_evidence: 3D Type object added with text 'FK - IK' and formatted near the hip region.

steps.goal: Add FK_IK_Switch attribute to the switch control object
steps.visual_evidence: Add Attribute window opened, creating FK_IK_Switch floating attribute from 0 to 1.

steps.goal: Connect FK_IK_Switch attribute to constraint weights using Node Editor and Reverse node
steps.visual_evidence: Node Editor shown connecting switch attribute directly to IK constraint weights and through a reverse node to FK constraint weights.

steps.goal: Test FK/IK blending functionality on the leg rig
steps.visual_evidence: Posing FK and IK legs separately, then scrubbing FK_IK_Switch value between 0 and 1 to show skin joint matching.
